title: Ezekiel 29
paragraphs: ¹ In the tenth year, in the tenth month on the twelfth day, the word of the LORD came to me: ² "Son of man, turn your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all of Egypt. ³ Speak and say: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your streams, who say, 'The Nile belongs to me; I made it for myself.' ⁴ But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales. I will pull you out from among your streams, with all the fish sticking to your scales. ⁵ I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and not be gathered up or picked up. I have given you as food to the animals of the earth and the birds of the air.

⁶ Then all who live in Egypt will know that I am the LORD. You have been a staff of reed for the people of Israel. ⁷ When they grasped you with their hands, you splintered and tore open their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke and their backs were wrenched. ⁸ Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will bring a sword against you and cut off from you both man and beast. ⁹ Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD. Because you said, 'The Nile is mine and I made it,' ¹⁰ therefore I am against you and against your streams, and I will make Egypt a ruin and a desolate wasteland from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.

¹¹ No human foot will pass through it and no animal foot will pass through it; it will be uninhabited for forty years. ¹² I will make Egypt the most desolate of countries, and her cities will be ruined for forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. ¹³ Yet this is what the Sovereign LORD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered. ¹⁴ I will bring back the captives of Egypt and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their origin, and there they will be a lowly kingdom. ¹⁵ It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations.

¹⁶ Egypt will no longer be a source of confidence for the people of Israel, but will be a reminder of their sin in turning to her for help. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign LORD. ¹⁷ In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me: ¹⁸ "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre; every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder made raw. Yet he and his army got no reward from the campaign he led against Tyre. ¹⁹ Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder the land as pay for his army. ²⁰ I have given him Egypt as a reward for his efforts, because he and his army did it for me, declares the Sovereign LORD.
²¹ On that day I will make a horn grow for the people of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
